name: Ningbo KBE Electrical Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo KBE Electrical Technology Co.,Ltd. provides automotive cable products and services in China and internationally. The company offers EV, data, and aluminum cables, as well as German, Japanese, American, ISO, and Chinese standard products. Its products include common wires, special materials, sheathed cables, shield cables, insulation low tension wires, multi-core sheath cables, and compressed cables. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China. Ningbo KBE Electrical Technology Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Ningbo Xinxie Industrial Group Co., Ltd.
